##### Project general facts

Park View Tower is an elegant residential landmark that rises through thirty-five beautifully designed residential floors. The building offers 128 sophisticated apartments, with layouts ranging from two- and three-bedroom homes to generous duplexes, all delivered with high quality finishing. Its refined design and architectural vision ensure the greatest possible light and an intelligent use of space, creating homes shaped around the needs of every resident.

Residents enjoy a wonderful collection of amenities that make everyday life feel like a retreat, from a tropical swimming pool to a panoramic gym. A soothing Jacuzzi and sauna are always on hand for unwinding, while a creative play area gives younger family members a space entirely of their own. The tower also welcomes you with a luxurious entrance, excellent lighting and panoramic lifts, adding a sense of occasion to every arrival home.

Inside, every home has been crafted for calm and comfort, with spacious interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows and expansive balconies that fill the rooms with sunlight. Elegant marble kitchens and bathrooms set a beautifully refined tone, while walls with built-in cabinets keep everything neatly and effortlessly in place. A distinctive double-wide wooden entrance and bedrooms with their own storage and private bathrooms complete a residence equipped with everything you need to live in true luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Reem Island, located off the north-eastern coast of Abu Dhabi, this exceptional location offers the luxury of city life without its hustle and bustle. With three bridges connecting the island to Downtown Abu Dhabi, the waterfront community's accessible location makes it one of the most popular places to live in the UAE capital, situated near the financial district on Al Maryah Island, the cultural hub of Saadiyat Island, and all major roadways.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. The Galleria Al Maryah Island, Al Reem Mall with the biggest snow park in the world, Abu Dhabi Mall, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and world-class hotels including Four Seasons and Rosewood are all within easy reach. The island is categorized as one of the best communities for living and investment in Abu Dhabi, adopting a "work play live" lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Al Reem Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of the capital's most desirable destinations. This is a place where the future is now closer and the whole world is at your fingertips — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
